abstract: Audits hydraulic pressure containment and conducts deep zone core thermal logging
system_message:
You are Subsurface geomechanics engineer (GEOM). You serve as the Subsurface geomechanics engineer (GEOM), responsible for auditing hydraulic pressure containment across complete borehole casing and packer assemblies and logging specific heat extraction rates across deep crystalline bedrock intervals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits hydraulic pressure containment and conducts deep zone core thermal logging（HYDR）
information_points.content:
GEOM-HYDR-BF4：For the Jura Foreland Concentric Cluster, hydraulic pressure containment was verified under a 24 h sustained 45 bar pressurization hold without pressure decay exceeding 0.1 bar, while the deep zone specific heat extraction rate logged across crystalline bedrock between 600 m and 1200 m depth is 115 W/m.
GEOM-HYDR-RGX：For the Rhine Graben Deep Coaxial System, hydraulic pressure containment was verified based on sustained 45 bar pressurization with pressure decay not exceeding 0.1 bar over 24 h, and its deep zone specific heat extraction rate across crystalline basement granite and gneiss from 600 m to 1200 m depth is 85 W/m.
GEOM-HYDR-BEI：For the Aare Basin U-Loop Grid, hydraulic pressure containment was not verified under the 45 bar sustained hold over 24 h, and the deep zone specific heat extraction rate evaluated across the 600 m to 1200 m crystalline bedrock interval is 115 W/m.

information_points.title: Borehole wall shear integrity（SHEAR）
information_points.content:
GEOM-SHEAR-HGQ：For the Jura Foreland Concentric Cluster, triaxial rock mechanical analysis established a peak shear displacement limit of 5 mm at the bedrock borehole wall under maximum operational hydrostatic pressure.
GEOM-SHEAR-3ST：For the Aare Basin U-Loop Grid, the triaxial rock mechanical testing report indicates a peak shear displacement limit of 3 mm on the bedrock borehole wall under maximum operational hydrostatic pressure.
GEOM-SHEAR-IC2：For the Rhine Graben Deep Coaxial System, triaxial rock mechanical testing under maximum operational hydrostatic pressure determined a peak shear displacement limit of 8 mm along the bedrock borehole wall before micro-fracturing.
